title: win_lose_eval's terminal guard is unreachable from its sole caller
detail: step returns when terminal before calling win_lose_eval, and flow_step (the only thing between) never sets terminal. So win_lose_eval's own terminal check can never fire — dead code, kept as defense-in-depth.
recommended_fix: Either drop the redundant check in win_lose_eval (the step barrier already enforces E17) or reword the comment to state it is intentional defense-in-depth for future direct callers.
